title: geoparquet-overviews
description: A reference/demo dataset for the draft "geoparquet-overviews" GeoParquet convention, which stores a simplified overview geometry alongside full-resolution geometry in a single file so it renders instantly in a web map while remaining fully SQL-queryable. It packages example conversions of Finnish national topographic (MTK) building and terrain features and Overture Maps building footprints for Tokyo, plus test fixtures for Barcelona, Luxembourg, and Reykjavik, across multiple convention versions (root, v0.1.0, v0.2.0, v0.3.0).
